name: mmo-city
description: Browser-based 3D MMO for 100 players: Three.js client, Colyseus server, SQLite persistence
author: smadrom

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p client
